normative_precedence: local/release.v1.json: selected scope and publication gates only
supported_host_target: Darwin with the exact qualified trusted-application sandbox and guardian
bootstrap_requirements: Exact descriptor, scope, package identities, and complete source projection parity.
All applicable Rust, Python, schema, cross-language, lifecycle, data, and negative controls.
Complete applicable consumer regressions with source inventory and security closure.
Standalone package build, locked dependencies, license inventory, and current vulnerability review.
Markdown, SVG, PDF, mathematical source parity, and accessible rendered-document verification.
Exact pushed code-and-documentation commits; no provider or scientific completion claim.
operational_requirements: Fresh installation from the exact bootstrap commits and immutable artifact roster.
Independent Rust/Python wire, semantic, digest, and retained-outcome qualification.
Actual four-owner NEST/CREBAIN/Galadriel/Prisoma simulation for every declared model and entity count.
Independent numerical and isolated kernel oracles; deterministic repeat and negative controls.
Every selected causal cut, response-loss, owner-death, resource, and capture-completeness control.
Actual host sandbox denial, private descriptor custody, lifecycle termination, and cleanup controls.
Exact installed configuration, latency/resource measurements, reproducibility commands, and disclosed limits.
Individual resolution of all 70 original acceptance requirements; exclusions remain explicitly excluded.
Matching terminal evidence, exact source/artifact hashes, and public/private distribution boundaries.
post_publication_requirements: Verify the exact remote tag and published artifact hashes.
Install and exercise the published artifacts through the documented access paths.
Verify repository, portfolio, SVG, and PDF status against the release receipt.
